name: Inquiry
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Inquiry form.
intro_text: Tell us briefly about your legal problem and we'll be in touch.

schema.label: Case Summary
schema.help: Please provide a short description of your legal problem (max 500 words)

name: Client Intake
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Client Intake form.
intro_text: Please answer as fully as you can. Approximations are fine — we'll confirm the details together.

schema.label: Is your mailing address the same as your home address?

options.label: Real estate purchase or sale (excluding fraud)

schema.label: Brief description of key events
schema.help: Please describe the key events in the dispute (max 500 words)

schema.label: Is the disputed property your home address?
Address of the property in dispute
Is the owner a business entity (LLC, corporation, etc.)?
Have you been served with legal papers, or do you know of any deadlines?
Describe the papers that were served to you
Current or past lawsuits involving you, and their status
schema.help: Include matters unrelated to this dispute. Write “None” if none.

schema.label: Have you consulted other attorneys about this matter?
If yes, please tell us who you consulted and when.
Have you posted about the dispute on social media?
If yes, please give the date and location of the post and describe its contents

name: Client Onboarding
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Client Onboarding form.
intro_text: A few details we need before we open your matter.

schema.label: How many clients will there be in this matter?
For each client beyond the second, please give the same details: person or entity, names, and full contact information.
Is this client a person or an entity?
Is this client a person or an entity?
Would you like to appoint a personal representative to act on your behalf in this matter?
Who should be our main point of contact?
If someone else, their name, relationship to you, phone, email, and mailing address.
Who should we contact when we cannot reach the main point of contact?
If someone else, their name, relationship to you, phone, email, and mailing address.
Who should receive invoices and billing correspondence?
If someone else, their name, relationship to you, phone, email, and mailing address.
Who will be paying the retainer?
If someone else, their full details: name, relationship to you, phone, email, and addresses.

name: Boundary Dispute Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Boundary Dispute Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to boundary disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

options.label: I may be encroaching on my neighbor

schema.label: What is the nature of the encroachment?
Approximate size or extent of the disputed area
schema.help: E.g. a two-foot strip along the fence line

schema.label: How long has the encroachment existed?
When and how did you first learn of it?
Have you communicated with your neighbor about the encroachment?
schema.help: By phone, text, email, or in person

schema.label: Do you have a survey of your property?
Who performed the survey, and when?
Are you aware of any other surveys, including conflicting ones?
Has anyone ever given permission for the encroachment?
Has a fence, wall, or line been treated as the boundary over the years?
Has either side built or improved on the disputed area?
How long have you owned your property, and how long has your neighbor owned or occupied theirs?
Do you have photographs of the disputed area?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. police reports, HOA involvement, a pending sale

name: Easement Dispute Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Easement Dispute Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to easement disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Does the easement cross your land, or do you use it?

options.label: I use it to reach or serve my property

schema.label: What is the easement used for?
Is the easement in a recorded document or deed?
Where is it recorded, and when was it created?
How long has the use been occurring?
Has the use been blocked or interfered with?
Has anyone ever given permission for the use?
Have you communicated with the other party about the easement?
Do you have a survey or plat showing the easement?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. photographs, prior lawsuits, a pending sale

name: Quiet Title Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Quiet Title Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to quiet title matters. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

options.label: A competing deed or claim of ownership
An old lien, mortgage, or judgment
A tax sale or tax deed

schema.label: Who else claims an interest, and what do they claim?
Which recorded documents are at issue, if known?
schema.help: E.g. a deed, lien, or judgment, with dates if known

schema.label: How did you acquire the property?
Are you currently in possession of the property?
Have you notified a title insurance company?
Are property taxes and any association dues current?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. prior title searches, attorney opinions, correspondence

name: Purchase / Sale Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Purchase / Sale Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to purchase and sale disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Are you the buyer or the seller?
Do you have a copy of the signed contract?
What went wrong?
schema.help: E.g. failure to close, disclosure issues, financing, inspection or repairs, title problems

schema.label: Earnest money: how much, and who holds it?
Has either side sent a notice of default or termination?
Real estate agents or brokers involved, if any

options.label: I want the sale to go through
I want money damages or my earnest money

schema.label: Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. appraisals, inspection reports, loan denial letters

name: Association Dispute Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Association Dispute Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to homeowner and condo association disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Are you a property owner or acting for the association?

options.label: A board member or the association

schema.label: Name of the association (and management company, if any)
Have violation notices or fines been issued?
Describe them, with dates and amounts
Are assessments current on the property?
Has a lien been recorded or threatened?
Has a hearing been held or scheduled?
Have you corresponded with the board or manager?
Which governing documents do you have?
schema.help: E.g. covenants (CC&Rs), bylaws, notices, meeting minutes

name: Landlord-Tenant Supplement (Landlord)
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Landlord-Tenant Supplement (Landlord) form.
intro_text: A few more questions for landlords. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Is the property residential or commercial?
Is there a written lease, and do you have a copy?
Lease term and monthly rent, if known
Amount of unpaid rent or damages, if any
Have you served any notices on the tenant?
schema.help: E.g. demand for possession, notice to vacate, dispossessory papers

schema.label: Is the tenant still in possession?
Has a court case been filed?
Which court, and what are the deadlines or hearing dates?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. the lease, a rent ledger or payment records, photographs

name: Landlord-Tenant Supplement (Tenant)
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Landlord-Tenant Supplement (Tenant) form.
intro_text: A few more questions for tenants. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Is the property residential or commercial?
Is there a written lease, and do you have a copy?
Lease term and monthly rent, if known

options.label: I am being evicted or threatened with eviction

schema.label: Have you received any notices from the landlord?
schema.help: E.g. demand for possession, notice to vacate, dispossessory papers

schema.label: Which notices, and when did you receive them?
If repairs are at issue: describe them, and when you reported them
Are you still living in or occupying the property?
Has a court case been filed?
Which court, and what are the deadlines or hearing dates?

name: Construction Dispute Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Construction Dispute Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to construction disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Is there a written contract, and do you have a copy?
Contract price, amount paid, and amount in dispute, if known
Has either party made a written demand under the Right to Repair Act?
Who sent it, when, and what was the response?
Has a lien been filed or threatened?
Have any inspections or expert reports been done?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. photographs, change orders, punch lists, correspondence

name: Real Estate Fraud Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Real Estate Fraud Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to real estate fraud. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: What was your role in the transaction?
What do you believe was misrepresented or concealed?
Describe what was said or concealed, and by whom
When and how did you discover it?
Date the contract was signed, if applicable
Date closing occurred, if it did
Was there a due diligence period?
Did you view the property before buying?
Do you have a copy of the inspector's report?
Was the problem you complain of covered in the inspector's report, or was it missed?

options.label: It was covered in the report

schema.label: Have you discussed the issue with the inspector?
What did you do in reliance on it?
schema.help: E.g. closed the purchase, wired funds, signed documents

schema.label: Approximate amount at stake or lost
Do you have documents supporting this?
schema.help: E.g. emails, texts, contracts, wire records, closing statements

schema.label: Have you reported it to police or a government agency?
Were any professionals involved?
schema.help: E.g. closing attorney, notary, agent, appraiser

name: Commercial Dispute Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Commercial Dispute Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to commercial disputes. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Your business's name and your role in it
What kind of dispute is it?
Is there a written contract, and do you have a copy?
When did the relationship begin, and when did the dispute arise?
Have demand letters been sent or received?
Is this a business relationship you want to preserve?
Anything else we should know?
schema.help: E.g. contracts, invoices, correspondence, operating agreements

name: Collections Supplement
description: Mirrors the Craig Legal website's Collections Supplement form.
intro_text: A few more questions specific to collections matters. Please answer as completely as you can; approximations are fine.

schema.label: Are you owed money, or is someone pursuing you?
Who is the other party?
schema.help: Name, and whether a business or individual

schema.label: What is the debt based on?
Do you have signed documents supporting the debt?
When did the debt arise, and when was the last payment?
Has a written demand been made?
By whom, when, and what was the response?
Is there already a court judgment?
